capabilities: Monitor remote Hermes Agent profiles on a canvas with sparklines, token and cost totals
Toggle skills and cron jobs and edit Soul, User and Memory documents per profile
View and update Kanban boards on the host with live updates and stuck-task notices
Chat with a profile from a side panel with a skills menu and queued messages
Show cron schedules in today and week calendar views
extras: Desktop only because it runs the system ssh binary; the README has a detailed security disclosure section covering spawned processes, network use, vault access, clipboard, stored data and telemetry.
problem: Hermes Agent profiles run on a remote host, so managing their boards, skills, schedules and sessions otherwise means working over SSH by hand.

relations.evidence: The host needs Hermes Agent with the hermes command on the PATH, and sqlite3.

requires.name: Hermes Agent (with hermes command and sqlite3 on the host) reachable via SSH

summary: SSH-based control panel for remote Hermes Agent profiles: canvas of profiles, kanban boards, skills, cron jobs and chat.
